_meta.io.cryptofeed402/use_when: Use when comparing crypto funding rates across venues for basis/carry or funding-arbitrage trades.

description: Use when comparing crypto funding rates across venues for basis/carry or funding-arbitrage trades. Cross-venue crypto funding rates spread ($0.005/call, USDC on Base via x402). For 1-20 symbols (default BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, NEAR, AAVE) returns Hyperliquid and OKX funding (Binance/Bybit when reachable) normalized to hourly and APR, with spread = max minus min per symbol. Fewer than 2 venues or bad params: error, no charge. Example: GET https://cryptofeed402.site/funding/spread?symbols=BTC,ETH
name: get_funding_spread

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired (what this MCP tool returns, isError=true)

symbols.description: Per symbol: symbol, venues[] (per-venue funding), spread{} (max-min)

title: Funding spread (paid, x402) — $0.005

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
